FAQ: Websites for business
What is the cost of building a business website?
You can sign up and build a business website for free. You may continue to run your website, completely free, for as long as you want, but most professionals require Premium features, such as a unique domain name, backup options, and removal of Webnode branding. So try us out for free, and when you're ready, you can easily upgrade to a Premium Plan.
Do I need a professional web designer for my business website?
It's easy to build your website yourself—without code or any web design knowledge. If you are comfortable using a point and click program like MS Word or Powerpoint, you will be able to build your website with Webnode.
Can I add a blog to my business website on Webnode?
Yes, you can easily add a news or blog section to keep your visitors informed of interesting and relevant information related to your industry and business.
Will my website be optimized for mobile devices too?
When you start a business website with us, know that it will automatically look good on any device, from mobile phones and tablets, to laptops and larger displays.
Can I create an international, multilingual business website on Webnode?
Absolutely! If you run an international business and want to reach people using a variety of languages, you can easily have multiple language versions of your site. The number of languages you can use depends on the plan that you choose.
